items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I watched this morning on YouTube the scene with Sonny & Cher.

ctx.x: And I was just, “Tom —” I’ve learned how to, you know, just go to someone else.

I watched this morning on YouTube the scene with Sonny & Cher. And I just couldn’t help but put myself in your place because I pictured you — “Oh they might do this song, I’ve got to have an oboe sound for one thing”
